name: Bridge Pickup Bite
description: The second pickup alone with the brilliant switch: hard, wiry and close.

name: Brilliant Only
description: The brilliant switch alone on the first pickup: a thin, piercing tone that cuts through any band.

name: Even Rhythm
description: The dynamics low so every note lands at the same level, treble and medium down: an even rhythm part that sits in a mix as if compressed.

name: Funk Both Pickups
description: Both pickups at the D position, brilliant and treble down: the full, biting rhythm sound.

name: Half Mute Funk
description: Both pickups at D, the mute halfway and the dynamics wide: a tight, popping rhythm where the ghost notes all but disappear.

name: Hard Snap
description: The hardest tangents, the keys' knock up and only brilliant and treble down: every note a snap.

name: Init
description: The instrument as its reference's patch loads: the first pickup, all four tone switches down, no mute.

name: Muted Staccato
description: The mute slider most of the way on and the yarn quick: short, plucked, woody notes.

name: Out of Phase Wah
description: Both pickups at B and D, out of phase, through the treble and medium switches: a hollow, vocal tone, as if a wah were parked halfway.

name: Pizzicato
description: The mute well on, the soft and medium switches and softish tangents: plucked, woody notes like pizzicato strings.

name: Reggae Chop
description: Both pickups at D, treble and medium down, the mute half on and the yarn quick: short, dry chops on the offbeat.

name: Ringing Harp
description: No mute, the strings and the release ringing long and soft tangents: picked notes that hang like a harp's.

name: Rock Rhythm
description: Both pickups at D and every switch down, the strings left to ring long: a full, bright rhythm sound for a rock band.

name: Soft Mellow
description: The soft and medium switches alone, a softer tangent: round, for chords under a band.

name: Thin Both Pickups
description: Both pickups at the B and D positions: the low strings thin out and the sound turns nasal and hollow.
